findings.location: Proof, step 6.1, second case s' < s
findings.evidence: The proof asserts s-s' <= |s-a_k| + (a_k-b_k) + |b_k-s'| < 2 epsilon. Since a_k <= b_k, the middle term is nonpositive and this is not a valid upper bound. Step 4.1 gives b_k-a_k < epsilon; the estimate closes with b_k-a_k in the sum, a 3 epsilon bound, and a choice 3 epsilon < s-s'.
